title: This is the biggest mindset shift you need when running ads... To par...
description: This is the biggest mindset shift you need when running ads... To paraphrase Meta's CMO "Short term pain, leads to long term gain."
transcript: I actually one of the biggest challenges is convincing them that their results are better than they think they are. Often you speak to a client, particularly if they're not running much paid ads, haven't got much history with it, and you say, what return on ad spend do you want? And they say like, oh, a 10 x return on ad spend on the initial transaction. Or if we factor in the lifetime value of a customer, that might be a 20 x return on ad spend. And often what they're trying to do is just fight to get a lower and lower cost to acquire a customer, when they're actually better off scaling, putting more time and effort into that customer lifetime value part. That's probably like, the hardest conversation that comes up again and again.
